choices.content: The elements must be written in ascending order.
Each element must be written at least twice.
It can only represent infinite sets.
The order of the elements can be changed without changing the set.

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct when representing a set using roster notation?

solutions.explanation: Roster notation does not depend on the order in which the elements are written. \(\{1,2\}\) and \(\{2,1\}\) are the same set.
solutions.title: Order independence of a roster
